name: UCI Bike Sharing Dataset
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) / Citation Required
citation: Fanaee-T, Hadi, and Gama, Joao, 'Event labeling combining ensemble detectors and background knowledge', Progress in Artificial Intelligence (2013): pp. 1-15, Springer Berlin Heidelberg, doi:10.1007/s13748-013-0040-3.
target_description: Total hourly count of rental bikes (sum of casual and registered users)

feature_descriptions.season: Season (1: Winter/Spring start, 2: Summer, 3: Fall, 4: Winter)
feature_descriptions.holiday: Whether the day is a holiday (1: Yes, 0: No)
feature_descriptions.weekday: Day of the week (0: Sunday to 6: Saturday)
feature_descriptions.workingday: Working day indicator (1: Neither weekend nor holiday, 0: Weekend or holiday)
feature_descriptions.weathersit: Weather category (1: Clear/Few clouds, 2: Mist/Cloudy, 3: Light Rain/Snow, 4: Heavy Rain/Ice/Fog)
feature_descriptions.atemp: Normalized feeling temperature in Celsius (divided by 50)
feature_descriptions.casual: Count of unregistered casual users (leakage component)
feature_descriptions.registered: Count of registered annual/monthly members (leakage component)
feature_descriptions.cnt: Count of total rental bikes (prediction target)

limitations: Aggregated city-level data for Washington, D.C.; cannot resolve spatial micro-movements.
Occasional missing hours during extreme weather events or late night maintenance.
Weather attributes are pre-normalized in the original UCI release.
Strong structural break / secular growth between 2011 and 2012 due to system adoption.
